constraints: the intervention must arise during genuine work and must not be manufactured for the trial
the fresh wakeup receives no raw transcript
every required claim is read from kan rather than copied from the trial prompt
the evidence source is an exact immutable git commit whose published kan claims are signature and CID checked by kan under explicitly named signing principals
bulk kan evidence is generated from that signed-claim checkout then parsed so each required CID has the expected author kind subject relationship and versioned block
the workflow itself launches a new Codex session without prior transcript and digest-addresses its typed raw events and exact final message

fresh wakeup evidence must contain a completed typed agent-message turn and a completed command event for kan show --all --json, binding exact claims and candidate rather than supplying token-bearing prose
